var speed = 30;

fill(0, 0, 0, 0);

var sw = 0.3;

var se = 9;

var se1 = 2;

var nse1 = -1;

var drawCurvePart = function(pt, pts, color) {

    stroke(color);

var c = pt;

if(c < pts.length - se) {

    bezier(pts[c][0], pts[c][1],

        pts[c][0]*nse1+

            pts[c+1][0]*se1,

        pts[c][1]*nse1+

            pts[c+1][1]*se1,

        pts[c+se][0]*nse1+

            pts[c+se-1][0]*se1,

        pts[c+se][1]*nse1+

            pts[c+se-1][1]*se1,

        pts[c+se][0], pts[c+se][1]);

    }

};

frameRate(speed);

var c = 0; // current curve

var p = 0; // current point

background(247, 252, 247);

var draw = function() {

    if(c < curves.length) {

       strokeWeight(sw);

       drawCurvePart(p, curves[c], color(0, 0, 0));

       p++;

       if(p === curves[c].length) {

           c++;

           p = 0;

       }

    }

};
